rules: NEVER use generic sans like Inter or Roboto for headings.
Use tracking-tight for all headings above 32px.
Jump between heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
Tinted Grey Rule: Never use pure black #000000 or pure #808080. Always tint neutrals.
Hover states must be explicitly defined for text (e.g., hover:bg-primary hover:text-white).
Limit primary color to CTAs, active states, and key data points.

dashboard_web.navigation: Collapsible left sidebar navigation (w-64) with brand logo and modular menu items.
dashboard_web.spacing: Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) for data correlation.
components: Top-left North Star metrics using bento grids (Do przypomnienia, Przypomniano, Zapisano, Odrzucono).
Classic charts (Area chart for 30-day reminder vs booking).
Dense data tables for Lista pacjentów (Patient list) with global filters.
dashboard_web.surface_style: Grid Borders / Technical Look. Flat solid background, 1px subtle border, no shadows for a crisp medical feel.

patient_mobile.navigation: Minimal top bar, floating action buttons.
patient_mobile.spacing: Generous spacing (p-6, p-8) to create trust and calmness.
components: Confirmation/Rejection buttons with distinct primary/accent styling.
patient_mobile.surface_style: Neumorphism / Tactile. Soft clean surfaces with slightly larger border-radius (rounded-2xl).

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg with clear interaction animations (hover:-translate-y-0.5, transition-transform).
components.inputs: Shadcn UI Input, Select, and Form components. Custom borders using #E5E7EB, focus ring with primary color.
components.tables: Shadcn Table for the patient list. Dense rows, sticky headers, explicit hover states.
components.calendar: Shadcn Calendar for booking. Do not use native <input type='date'>.

motion: Staggered entrance animations for dashboard cards (Framer Motion).
Smooth state changes for booking steps in the patient view.
Micro-animations on hover for all interactive elements.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react for all standard iconography (dashboard menus, actions).
visual_enhancers.data_viz: Use Recharts (Shadcn chart) for the ROI / 30-day recall vs booked chart.

patient_view_hero.description: Smiling female medical professional posing in a modern dental clinic. Use this in the patient-facing mobile booking flow to build trust.

rules: Images must be responsive and not exceed 80vh on mobile.
Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text.
Include data-testid attribute on ALL interactive and key informational elements (buttons, inputs, menu items, table rows).
Keyboard navigable forms and data grids.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a dual-interface application: A web-first dashboard for clinic admins, and a mobile-first booking landing page for patients.

Implement the Dashboard with a left sidebar layout, top stat cards (bento style), a 30-day line/area chart using Recharts, a data table for patients, and a settings view for recall intervals and SMS/Email templates.

Implement the Mobile Patient View as a separate route (e.g. /booking/:id) simulating a mobile screen. It should feature a friendly greeting, a Shadcn calendar for date selection, and clear Accept/Reject actions.
Ensure all text is in Polish as per the problem statement (e.g. 'Do przypomnienia', 'Lista pacjentów', 'Raport ROI').
Use Outfit for headings and DM Sans for body text.
Ensure the dashboard cards do NOT have heavy shadows; use a 1px subtle border for a clean, medical SaaS look.
Add 'data-testid' to every button, link, and input.
Use Tailwind CSS for all styling, avoid generic centered text.
